verdict.rationale: Substantive text was extracted from the main guidance pages on corp.delaware.gov (howtoform, paytaxes, frtax, fee, homepage). That implies those pages serve readable HTML to a keyless fetcher rather than a JS-only shell or challenge page. Probes against the same host returned clean HTTP 404s, not bot-wall blocks. The only documented CAPTCHA sits on the transactional franchise-tax entry page on icis.corp.delaware.gov, which is not the public guidance reading surface. Missing for 10: an explicit probe recording a 200 response with an identified user agent on the guidance pages, a corp.delaware.gov robots.txt/crawl-policy check, and independent hands-on confirmation of agent access.
